manifest.name: Core Rules (5e)
manifest.description: Core races, classes, backgrounds, spells, and equipment for D&D 5th Edition (2014)
manifest.author: Character Wizard

races.name: Human
races.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most adaptable of all races. In the worlds of D&D, they are the youngest of the common races, but they strive for greatness.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in places of ethereal beauty. They love nature and magic, art and artistry, music and poetry.

subraces.name: High Elf
subraces.description: High elves have keen minds and a mastery of basic magic.

subraces.name: Wood Elf
subraces.description: Wood elves have keen senses and intuition, moving swiftly through their native forests.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Fighters learn the basics of all combat styles.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality through careful study and practice of arcane magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a student of arcane magic, you have a spellbook containing spells that show the first glimmerings of your true power.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, and learned basic survival techniques.

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence, and they defer to you if they are of a lower rank.

personalityTraits: I'm haunted by memories of war.
I enjoy being strong and breaking things.
ideals: Greater Good. Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others.
Responsibility. I do what I must and obey just authority.
Independence. When people follow orders blindly, they embrace tyranny.
bonds: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield.
flaws: I obey the law, even if it causes misery.
I made a terrible mistake that cost many lives.
My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. You scoured manuscripts, studied scrolls, and listened to the greatest experts on the subjects that interest you.

feature.name: Researcher
feature.description: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you do not know that information, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it.

personalityTraits: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.
I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries.
I'm used to helping out those who aren't as smart as I am.
There's nothing I like more than a good mystery.
ideals: Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge.
Beauty. What is beautiful points us beyond itself toward what is true.
Logic. Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking.
bonds: It is my duty to protect my students.
I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets.
I work to preserve a library or university.
flaws: I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
Most people scream and run when they see a demon. I stop and take notes.
I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again. You can use your action to control the hand and use it to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
spells.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Sleep

components.material: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket

spells.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points.
spells.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
spells.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
spells.higherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

equipment.name: Backpack
equipment.description: A leather pack carried on the back, suitable for holding gear.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.description: A torch burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

equipment.name: Rations (1 day)
equipment.description: Rations consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

equipment.name: Spellbook
equipment.description: Essential for wizards, this leather-bound book serves as a repository for spells.

equipment.name: Component Pouch
equipment.description: A small, watertight leather belt pouch that contains all the material components and other special items needed to cast spells.

equipment.name: Arcane Focus (Crystal)
equipment.description: An arcane focus is a special item designed to channel the power of arcane spells.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
